title: R--7TH FLEET AREA OF OPERATIONS (AO) REGION 2 HUSBANDING SUPPORT SERVICES, MULTIPLE AWARD CONTRACTS (MAC) REQUIREMENT
description_text: *** Pursuant to FAR 5.202(a) (12), this is a non-mandatory synopsis. This announcement and the subsequent solicitation for this requirement is intended only for sources duly authorized to operate and do business in Brunei, Cambodia, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam as prescribed by DFARS 225.1103(3).*** The NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Yokosuka (FLCY) Site Singapore intends to issue a solicitation for award of several Multiple-Award Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite- Quantity (IDIQ) contracts in accordance with FAR Part 15 procedures, to obtain non-personal, Husbanding Services for United States Ships (USS) and United Stated Naval Ships (USNS), to include the Military Sealift Command and United States Coast Guard visiting ALL commercial and military ports located in Region 2 of the U.S. 7th Fleet area of operations (AO), which consists of the FOLLOWING region 2 countries: Sub-region 1 Country of Hong Kong ports as follows: Port of Hong Kong Sub-region 2 Country of Philippines ports as follows: Subic Bay Manila Palawan Cebu Sub-region 3 Country of Brunei ports as follows: Muara Country of Cambodia ports as follows: Sihanoukville Ream Country-Indonesia ports as follows: Jakarta Surabaya Bali â Benoa, Banyuwangi Batam Makassar Maluku Belawan Country of Malaysia ports as follows: Lumut Kota Kinabalu Penang Sepangar Kuantan Naval base Kuantan Kemaman Langkawi Port Klang Country-Singapore ports as follows: Changi Naval Base Sembawang Country-Thailand ports as follows: Laem Chabang Phuket Sattahip Si Racha Country-Vietnam ports as follows: Da Nang Cam Ranh Bay It is anticipated that Multiple Award Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity, Firm-Fixed-Price contracts (FFP IDIQ MAC) will be issued with an ordering/performance period of 18 months. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) for these requirements is 561990 with a Size Standard of $11 million. The corresponding Federal Supply Code (FSC) is R706. The solicitation will be issued as a Request for Proposal (RFP) under full and open competition under solicitation number N40345-17-R-0121 around 15 September 2017 or sooner. The solicitation response time will be no less than 14 days upon issuance. Potential offerors are hereby notified that this synopsis and any amendments and the subsequent solicitation and any amendments to the solicitation will only be available by downloading the documents at Asia Navy Electronic Business Opportunities (AsiaNECO) at website: https://asia.neco.navy.mil/ (until further notice), Federal Business Opportunities (FEDBIZOPPS) at website: https://www.fbo.gov/, and Neco https://www.neco.navy.mil (starting around 15 September 2017 or sooner). Potential offerors are hereby notified that they should register and get an active account in AsiaNECO website to be able to see the solicitation when it is posted to AsiaNECO. The Government is not responsible for any inability of the offerors to access the posted documents. No telephone or FAX requests will be accepted, and no hard-copy solicitation or amendment will be mailed or faxed to Offerors. By submitting a proposal in response to the solicitation, the offeror will be self-certifying that neither the requestor nor the principal corporate officials and owners are currently suspended, debarred, or otherwise ineligible to receive contracts from any Federal Agency. Failure to do so may represent grounds for refusing to accept the proposal. By submission of a proposal, the offeror acknowledges the requirement that prospective awardees must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database prior to award. Lack of registration in the SAM database will make an offeror ineligible for award. Offerors may obtain information on registration and annual confirmation requirements via the internet at https://www.sam.gov/. The point of contact (POC) for this requirement is: Mr. James Sinclair, Contract Specialist at James.Sinclair@fe.navy.mil, and Please make sure to include all the above listed contact when sending any e-mails.
